invoice.label: Invoice
invoice.hint: Bills for goods or services: vendor, totals, dates, line items.

fields.description: Company issuing the invoice, usually the largest text at the top
The invoice reference number, often labelled Invoice No or INV
Date the invoice was issued
Date payment is due, not the invoice date
Company or person being billed, usually under Bill To
Final total payable including tax and shipping, as a decimal number
ISO currency code of the total, e.g. USD, EUR
PO or purchase order number if present
Whether the invoice is marked as paid
Each billed line: what was sold, how many, and the line amount

paystub.label: Paystub
paystub.hint: Earnings statements: gross and net pay, hours, deductions.

fields.description: Full name of the employee being paid
Company issuing the paystub
Employee identification number
Date the pay was issued
First day of the pay period
Last day of the pay period
Gross pay for this period only, before deductions; not the year-to-date column
Net pay, the amount actually deposited after deductions
Regular hours worked this period
Total gross earnings year to date
Total of all deductions this period
Name of the financial institution
Full name of the account holder
Account number; if partly masked, return the visible digits
First day of the statement period
Last day of the statement period
Opening or beginning balance for the period
Closing or ending balance for the period
Total credits or deposits during the period, if shown
Each transaction line: the date, its description, and the amount

lending_application.label: Lending application
lending_application.hint: Loan and mortgage forms: borrower, income, loan terms.

fields.description: Full legal name of the applicant
Loan or application reference number
Date the application was signed or submitted
Borrower date of birth
Borrower current employer
Total gross monthly income in money units, as a number
Amount the borrower is requesting to borrow
Purchase price of the property
Down payment amount
Interest rate as a percentage
Loan term in months
Borrower credit score
Full address of the property being financed
